realdata_unused.protocol: Leave one device out. First 15 percent of cycle trajectory predicts median final one percent VCE,sat.
realdata_unused.caveat: Power cycling degradation, not burn-in. Same early-to-late forecasting structure.

realdata_unused.dataset: CORA.RDR Si IGBT accelerated power cycling
realdata_unused.lots_definition: one continuously aged physical device per file
realdata_unused.protocol: On-state Vce is averaged per eight-second cycle after rejecting off-state and artifact samples. The first 15, 25 or 50 percent of each device trajectory predicts the median final one percent. Ratio priors use the other two devices only.
realdata_unused.caveat: Accelerated power cycling to failure, not component burn-in. DUT2 was preconditioned by cutting one of six bond wires. Three devices are too few for a production performance claim.
